facilityType: A premier health and rehabilitation center
description:
Join a dedicated team at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Oakland, MD, as an SDC/Infection Control Nurse. This vital role combines the critical functions of staff development and infection prevention, ensuring our team is well-trained and our environment is safe for all residents and staff. You will play a key part in maintaining high standards of care and compliance.

In this dual-focused position, you will be responsible for coordinating educational programs for staff, assessing competencies, and implementing robust infection control protocols. Your expertise will be crucial in fostering a culture of continuous learning and safety. We are seeking a proactive and knowledgeable professional to contribute to our mission of providing exceptional care.

We offer a competitive hourly rate of $40-$42, reflecting the importance of this role. If you are an experienced Registered Nurse with a passion for education and infection prevention, we encourage you to apply and make a significant impact on our community.
requirements: Experience in staff development or education
Experience in infection prevention and control
Knowledge of current infection control guidelines and regulations

description: Join a dedicated team at a premier skilled nursing facility in Inverness, FL, as a Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA). This PRN opportunity offers the flexibility to work as needed, supporting patients on their journey to recovery and improved mobility. You will play a crucial role in implementing individualized treatment plans under the supervision of a licensed Physical Therapist.As a PRN PTA, you will assist patients with therapeutic exercises, functional training, and other rehabilitation activities, ensuring a safe and supportive environment. Your contributions will directly impact patient outcomes, helping them regain independence and enhance their quality of life. This role is perfect for a compassionate and skilled professional seeking flexible work arrangements.We offer competitive hourly compensation for this PRN position. If you are a motivated PTA looking to make a difference in a dynamic healthcare setting, we encourage you to apply today.
requirements: Associate's degree from an accredited Physical Therapist Assistant program
Current state licensure as a Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA)
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly compensation ranges from $28.00 to $37.00, based on experience.
